title: Term Loan Origination Software: 8 Platforms Compared for Business Lenders
summary: Compare eight term loan origination software platforms for business and commercial lending. See what a term lending system must handle and how Lendflow adds data, decisioning, and automation to your existing system.
body_markdown:
Term loan origination software is the system a lender uses to move a fixed-amount loan from application through underwriting, pricing, approval, closing, and funding. It then hands the loan to servicing with its repayment schedule attached. For business and commercial term lending, the strongest shortlist is LoanPro, nCino, Abrigo, Finastra Loan IQ, TurnKey Lender, HES LoanBox, DigiFi, and LendAPI.


The right choice depends on your borrower segment, deal size, and how much engineering capacity your team has.[Straits Research](https://straitsresearch.com/report/loan-origination-software-market) values the global loan origination software market at $7.29 billion in 2026 and projects $16.21 billion by 2034. That estimate covers all loan types, so the term lending share is smaller.


Most comparison guides treat every loan type the same way. This guide covers what term lending requires, why mortgage-first tools struggle with business term loans, and how each platform fits a term lender's workflow.


### What Term Loan Origination Software Has to Handle


A term loan origination system has to do more than collect an application and route it for approval. It has to underwrite a business's ability to repay a fixed amount over a fixed schedule, and then structure that schedule correctly.


#### How Term Loans Differ From Other Credit Products


A term loan delivers a fixed principal amount upfront, and the borrower repays it in scheduled installments over a set term. Each payment follows an amortization schedule that splits principal and interest, at either a fixed or variable rate.


That structure is very different from a revolving line of credit, a merchant cash advance, or invoice factoring. Because the lender commits the full amount on day one, underwriting has to prove that future cash flow can cover every scheduled payment through maturity.


Business and commercial term lending adds further complexity, because applications often involve guarantors, collateral, financial statements, and covenants. A small business term loan and a large syndicated commercial facility share the same basic structure, but they need very different levels of software depth.


#### Core Capabilities a Term Lending LOS Needs


Term loan origination software earns its place when it handles five jobs well. Each one maps to a point where term lending deals commonly stall or lose accuracy.


Cash-Flow and Bank Data Underwriting


Term lenders need to see how money actually moves through a business, so the LOS should pull bank data and accounting records directly. It should then calculate cash-flow and debt service coverage metrics without forcing underwriters to re-key figures into spreadsheets.


Document Collection and Verification


Business term loans require tax returns, bank statements, financial statements, IDs, and entity documents.[Multimodal](https://www.multimodal.dev/post/best-loan-origination-software) notes that most delay in a loan file sits in document collection and stipulation clearing, so this capability deserves close scrutiny in every demo.


Pricing and Term Structuring


The system should let your team set rates, fees, term lengths, and repayment frequency for each product, and then generate an accurate amortization schedule.[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) describes this as a pricing and terms engine that assigns interest rates, fees, and repayment schedules based on risk and customer profile.


Decisioning and Adverse Action


Rules-based or model-driven decisioning keeps approvals consistent across underwriters and channels. Declines also need clear reasons, because[Regulation B](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-12/chapter-X/part-1002/section-1002.9) requires a specific statement of the principal reasons for adverse action.


Clean Handoff to Servicing


Once a term loan funds, the approved terms, amortization schedule, and borrower records must move into servicing without manual re-entry. Some platforms cover both origination and servicing, while others rely on integrations to make that handoff.


#### Why Mortgage-Only Tools Fit Term Lending Poorly


Mortgage loan origination systems are built around residential home lending, which has its own documents, disclosures, and regulations.[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) explains that mortgage software is designed around TRID disclosures, HMDA reporting, and GSE delivery requirements.


Those strengths do little for a lender underwriting a five-year equipment or working capital term loan for a small business.[LoanPro](https://www.loanpro.io/blog/best-loan-origination-software) describes Encompass as built specifically for mortgage and says it does not serve multi-product lenders well.


[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) describes LendingPad as a mortgage LOS, and[LoanPro](https://www.loanpro.io/blog/best-loan-origination-software) describes Blend as best suited to mortgage and consumer front ends. Term lenders that adopt them usually end up adding separate tools for business underwriting, cash-flow analysis, and commercial documents.

#### 1. LoanPro


[LoanPro](https://www.loanpro.io/platform/origination-suite/) is an API-first lending platform that covers origination, servicing, collections, and payments. LoanPro reports that it works with more than 600 lenders across multiple asset classes.


**Best for:** Lenders that want origination and servicing on one platform, with deep configuration of products, workflows, and rules.


**Term loan fit:**[Multimodal](https://www.multimodal.dev/post/best-loan-origination-software) highlights its real-time amortization and integrated payments, which simplifies the handoff from a funded term loan into servicing.


**Watch for:** LoanPro's own guide notes that implementation can be more involved than point solutions and may exceed the needs of very small operations.


#### 2. nCino


[nCino](https://www.ncino.com/solutions/commercial-lending) offers commercial lending software that covers origination, credit analysis, and covenant tracking. According to[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) , nCino runs on Salesforce and supports commercial, SME, and mortgage lending.


**Best for:** Mid-size and large banks that already run on Salesforce or plan to build around it.


**Term loan fit:**[Multimodal](https://www.multimodal.dev/post/best-loan-origination-software) cites commercial spreads, credit memoing, and covenant tracking, which matter for underwriting commercial term loans.


**Watch for:** In[LoanPro's assessment](https://www.loanpro.io/blog/best-loan-origination-software) , heavy reliance on Salesforce can add cost and complexity, and implementation timelines can be long.


#### 3. Abrigo


[Abrigo](https://www.abrigo.com/software/lending-and-credit-risk/) provides lending and credit risk software for banks and credit unions. The same vendor also covers CECL, AML/BSA, and portfolio risk.


**Best for:** Banks and credit unions that want commercial origination tied directly to credit risk and compliance tooling.


**Term loan fit:**[LoanPro](https://www.loanpro.io/blog/best-loan-origination-software) describes Abrigo as having strong roots in commercial, SBA, and CRE lending, which aligns with community bank term lending.


**Watch for:** In[LoanPro's assessment](https://www.loanpro.io/blog/best-loan-origination-software) , Abrigo can involve a steep learning curve and offers less flexibility for digital-first lending experiences.


#### 4. Finastra Loan IQ


According to[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) , Finastra Loan IQ manages commercial lending from origination intake through servicing, trading, settlement, and closure within one system. HES FinTech positions it for large banks handling syndicated, commercial, and corporate lending.


**Best for:** Large institutions with complex deal structures, multi-lender facilities, and strict regulatory control requirements.


**Term loan fit:**[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) notes that it handles multi-tranche and multi-currency facilities, which suits large syndicated term loans more than small business volume.


**Watch for:**[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) reports that implementation can take a long time and may require specialized expertise and significant integration work.


#### 5. TurnKey Lender


[TurnKey Lender](https://www.turnkey-lender.com/loan-origination-system/) is a cloud-based lending platform focused on automation, decisioning, and AI-driven credit evaluation. It combines machine learning with rules-based decisioning and built-in scoring models.


**Best for:** Lenders that want automated decisioning and quicker deployment than legacy systems allow.


**Term loan fit:** Built-in scoring helps standardize approvals for higher-volume small business term loans with consistent credit criteria.


**Watch for:** In[LoanPro's assessment](https://www.loanpro.io/blog/best-loan-origination-software) , customization can be more limited than on API-first platforms. LoanPro also raises possible compliance questions about black-box models and document automation.


#### 6. HES LoanBox


[HES LoanBox](https://hesfintech.com/loan-origination-software/) is a modular origination platform that supports SME lending, with an optional servicing module. Institutions can license the source code, and the platform is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certified.


**Best for:** Non-bank lenders and mid-sized banks that need multi-product flexibility and deep customization.


**Term loan fit:** Its no-code product engine configures terms, rates, and repayment schedules, and its servicing module covers repayments and rescheduling.


**Watch for:**[HES FinTech's own review](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) notes that some clients needed extra planning for custom reporting, dashboards, and user roles during deployment. Licenses start from $39K per year, according to the same review.


#### 7. DigiFi


[DigiFi](https://www.digifi.io/loan-origination-system) offers API-first lending infrastructure built for embedded finance and fintech use cases. The platform bundles a loan origination system, an account opening system, and a decision engine.


**Best for:** Digital-first lenders and platforms embedding term loans into their own products.


**Term loan fit:** Real-time decisioning and support for multiple credit products suit lenders offering term loans through digital channels.


**Watch for:** In[LoanPro's assessment](https://www.loanpro.io/blog/best-loan-origination-software) , DigiFi may require significant development resources.[Guideflow](https://www.guideflow.com/blog/loan-origination-software) reports platform pricing from $3,995 per month.


#### 8. LendAPI


[LendAPI](https://www.lendapi.com/loan-origination-system) is a no-code onboarding and lending platform for banks and fintechs. Its toolkit centers on a Product Builder, a Decision Engine, and Workflow Orchestration.


**Best for:** Startups and product-led lenders testing a new term loan product before scaling.


**Term loan fit:** Teams can configure a lending product and its decision logic quickly, which shortens the path to a live term loan workflow.


**Watch for:** In[LoanPro's assessment](https://www.loanpro.io/blog/best-loan-origination-software) , LendAPI is a toolkit for building a custom LOS rather than a full LOS out of the box.[Guideflow](https://www.guideflow.com/blog/loan-origination-software) lists plans from $999 per month with a free trial.


### Best Practices for Choosing Term Loan Origination Software


A strong demo rarely shows the edge cases that slow term lending down. These practices help your team test each platform against the deals you actually originate.


#### Rebuild a Real Term Loan Product in the Demo


[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) recommends having each vendor rebuild one of your actual loan products and one actual approval flow. Bring a recent term loan file with real bank statements, guarantors, and pricing so the comparison reflects your workflow.


#### Stress-Test Amortization and Pricing Rules


Ask each vendor to configure interest-only periods, origination fees, prepayment terms, and different repayment frequencies. Then confirm that the amortization schedule matches what your servicing team expects to receive at funding.


#### Pressure-Test Bank Data and Document Intake


Watch how the platform pulls bank data, extracts figures from tax returns, and flags missing documents. If underwriters still re-key cash-flow figures by hand, a dedicated layer such as[Lendflow Automate](https://www.lendflow.com/lendflow-automate) can close that gap without replacing the LOS.


#### Plan for Business Lending Compliance


Confirm that every decline produces specific adverse action reasons your team can trace back to policy. If you originate small business credit,[Multimodal](https://www.multimodal.dev/post/best-loan-origination-software) advises confirming the system captures what the[CFPB's small business lending rule](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/1071-rule/) requires by January 1, 2028.


#### Budget for the Full Implementation Timeline


In its guide's FAQ,[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) estimates eight to twelve weeks for a single-product SaaS deployment and four to six months for mid-market rollouts. Enterprise deployments can run nine to fifteen months, so factor that time into your total cost of ownership.


#### Avoid Buying a Mortgage LOS for Business Term Loans


A mortgage-first platform can look complete in a demo while lacking cash-flow underwriting, commercial documents, and business entity checks. Choose a platform built for business or multi-product lending, and add specialized data or decisioning layers only where gaps remain.


### Match the Platform to the Term Loans You Originate


The best term loan origination software is the one that fits your borrowers, deal sizes, and team. Large banks with syndicated facilities lean toward Finastra Loan IQ or nCino, while community banks often favor Abrigo.


Lenders that want origination and servicing together should evaluate LoanPro or HES LoanBox. Digital-first and startup lenders should look at TurnKey Lender, DigiFi, or LendAPI.


Whichever system you choose, underwriting speed depends on the data and automation that feed it.[Lendflow Connect](https://www.lendflow.com/lendflow-connect) ,[Lendflow Intelligence](https://www.lendflow.com/lendflow-intelligence) , and Lendflow Automate plug into that LOS to speed up data collection, decisions, and document review.


### Term Loan Origination Software FAQs


#### What Is the Difference Between Term Loan Origination and Servicing?


Origination covers everything from application through underwriting, pricing, approval, closing, and funding. Servicing begins after funding and manages scheduled payments, interest, statements, and collections for the life of the term loan.


#### Who Is Eligible for a Term Loan?


Eligibility depends on the lender, but most business term lenders review time in business, revenue, credit history, and cash flow that can cover scheduled payments. For SBA 7(a) loans, the[U.S. Small Business Administration](https://www.sba.gov/funding-programs/loans/7a-loans) requires an operating, for-profit, U.S.-based small business that is creditworthy and can reasonably repay.


#### How Much Does Term Loan Origination Software Cost?


Most enterprise vendors, including nCino, Abrigo, and Finastra, quote pricing on request. Among published prices,[Guideflow](https://www.guideflow.com/blog/loan-origination-software) lists LendAPI from $999 per month and DigiFi from $3,995 per month.[HES FinTech](https://hesfintech.com/blog/top-best-loan-origination-software) lists HES LoanBox licenses from $39K per year.


#### Can a Mortgage LOS Handle Business Term Loans?


A mortgage LOS is built around residential lending requirements such as TRID and HMDA, so it usually lacks business underwriting tools. Lenders offering business or commercial term loans generally get a better fit from a multi-product or commercial lending platform.
